long_biography.plain_text:
Yoda PLC gives Vasileios Papalekas an investment interest spanning real estate, hospitality and other assets. The group has developed properties, held hotels and allocated capital across a wider portfolio through a listed company and private subsidiaries.

Vasileios participates through a substantial direct stake that has remained material across reporting periods. Day-to-day responsibility sits with the company’s board and management team, leaving his documented position centred on ownership. That structure gives him broad sector exposure without requiring an operating title and distinguishes his economic role from those responsible for founding and managing the group.
